description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget named AppShell that manages bottom navigation with multiple nested navigators, providing a tabbed interface with animated transitions among the tabs.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages a bottom navigation bar with multiple nested navigators, providing tabbed navigation with animated transitions.

classes.name: _AppShellState
classes.description: The state class for AppShell, manages the current tab index, navigator keys, and builds the UI with animated transitions and bottom navigation.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the AppShell widget.

methods.name: _selectTab
methods.description: Handles tab selection, resets navigation stack if current tab is re-selected.

methods.name: _buildTabNavigator
methods.description: Constructs a Navigator widget for each tab, with its own stack and route handling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including animated transitions between tabs and the bottom navigation bar.
